tool_args.rationale: The response changes abruptly from 1.67 at s_grad 2.78 to -2.30 at 3.58, inconsistent with simply extending the initial monotone-concave trend. A fine trajectory batch can resolve the transition region needed to identify and confirm the quantitative law.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a stationary smooth model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The added high-gradient rows reveal a sharp positive-to-negative transition between s_grad 2.78 and 3.58; eight rows do not locate or identify its threshold shape to the required tolerance.
It does not resolve the observed response transition.
The existing high-gradient measurements already establish the negative-response regime; finer sampling around the transition is more discriminating.
